transcript.text: Hi everyone. As we know, I've got the DNA testing kit and I'll be making the final call on whether it gets mailed and how the account is set up. Before I do anything, let's go around and hear from everyone — anything you think should shape the decision about law-enforcement matching, sample retention, sharing ancestry results, or anything else. What's on your minds?

transcript.text: I want to be upfront about my own condition for participating. I'll only provide my saliva sample if two settings are configured: law-enforcement matching turned off, and the biological sample destroyed after the results are issued. If the account is set up differently, I'd rather sit this one out.

First, the kit has to be activated by June 30, 2027 — so we have a hard deadline. Second, even if we select sample destruction as an option, the terms say raw biological data can only be destroyed by requesting destruction within 30 days after results arrive.
